Name: (CP) Recipe Fixes
Author: Solcohedron
Description:
[size=3]Changes various recipes to better fit how you would make them in real life, as well as:[list]
[*][size=3]Edited vanilla sprites[/size]
[*][size=3]Price + Cooking channel adjustments to fit the recipe changes[/size]
[*][size=3]The names + descriptions of a few dishes (e.g. blackberry cobbler ==> blackberry pie) to better fit the vanilla sprites[/size]
[/list]
If you want to use vanilla/another mod's food sprites, you can disable this mod's sprites with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Config Mod Menu[/url]﻿.
[/size]
